instruments.title: Merchant Shipping Act (as amended)
instruments.summary: Principal statute governing merchant shipping — registration, certification, safety, crew and liability.

instruments.title: International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea (SOLAS), 1974
instruments.summary: Core IMO convention on ship safety — construction, fire protection, life-saving, radio, navigation.

instruments.title: International Convention for the Prevention of Pollution from Ships (MARPOL)
instruments.summary: Annexes I-VI: oil, chemicals, packaged goods, sewage, garbage and air emissions from ships.

instruments.title: International Convention on Standards of Training, Certification and Watchkeeping (STCW)
instruments.summary: Competency standards, certification and watchkeeping arrangements for seafarers, as amended at Manila in 2010.

instruments.title: Maritime Labour Convention, 2006
instruments.summary: Minimum conditions of employment, hours of work and rest, accommodation, medical care and social protection for seafarers.

instruments.title: Convention on Facilitation of International Maritime Traffic (FAL), 1965
instruments.summary: Standardised declarations and electronic single-window arrangements for ship arrival, stay and departure.

instruments.title: Merchant Shipping (Standards of Training, Certification and Watchkeeping) Rules
instruments.summary: National implementation of STCW 2010 (Manila amendments) — competency, certification and watchkeeping.

instruments.title: Merchant Shipping (Registration of Ships) Rules
instruments.summary: Procedure for provisional and permanent registration, carving and marking, transfer, mortgage and closure of registry.

instruments.title: Merchant Shipping (Survey and Certification) Rules
instruments.summary: Initial, annual, intermediate and renewal survey regime and the endorsement of statutory certificates.

instruments.title: Container VGM declaration — interim procedure
instruments.summary: First interim arrangement for Verified Gross Mass declarations, pending weighbridge commissioning.

instruments.title: Container VGM verification procedure at the gate
instruments.summary: Verified Gross Mass to be declared and weighed at the terminal gate for all export containers per SOLAS Ch VI reg 2.
instruments.body: Shipping agents and customs brokers shall submit VGM via Method 1 (weighing the packed container) at the terminal gate weighbridge; Method 2 (calculated) declarations must carry the shipper's certified weighing procedure on file. Containers without a VGM record on file will not be permitted to load.

instruments.title: Container VGM — automated weighbridge capture and tolerance
instruments.summary: VGM captured automatically at the gate weighbridge; a 500 kg tolerance applies against the declared figure, above which the container is held.
instruments.body: From the effective date the terminal gate weighbridge writes the Verified Gross Mass directly to the container record. Where the weighed figure differs from the declared figure by more than 500 kg, the container is held and the agent notified for re-declaration. Method 2 declarations remain acceptable where the shipper's certified weighing procedure is on file.

instruments.title: Pre-arrival notification format revised — IMO FAL forms
instruments.summary: Interim paper and email FAL format ahead of the single-window rollout.

instruments.title: Electronic port clearance — mandatory FAL declarations via portal
instruments.summary: All agents to submit FAL 1-7 declarations electronically; paper submissions cease from the effective date.
instruments.body: Pursuant to the FAL Convention (2022 amendments), all shipping agents shall lodge General Declaration, Cargo Declaration, Ship Stores, Crew Effects, Crew List, Passenger List and Dangerous Goods declarations through the port community interface. Paper declarations will not be accepted after the effective date except for declared system outages.

instruments.title: Anchorage allocation policy — priority matrix
instruments.summary: Priority matrix for anchorage allocation by vessel class, cargo and declared readiness.

instruments.title: Monsoon working restrictions — West Basin and outer anchorage
instruments.summary: Cape vessels to maintain 20% additional UKC at WB berths during the SW monsoon; bunkering suspended at outer anchorage above sea state 5.
instruments.body: During the South-West monsoon period, all capesize vessels berthing at WB-1/WB-2 shall maintain an additional 20% under-keel clearance over the declared minimum. Bunker barge operations at the outer anchorage stand suspended whenever sea state exceeds 5 or wind exceeds 25 knots sustained. Masters shall confirm compliance on the pre-arrival checklist.

instruments.title: Revised garbage reception fees under MARPOL Annex V
instruments.summary: Garbage reception charge revised; segregation certificate required from vessels landing more than 2 cubic metres.

instruments.title: Garbage reception fees — revised schedule
instruments.summary: Garbage reception charge schedule by volume band and waste stream, with the segregation certificate requirement.

instruments.title: Security level 1 in force — access control reminders
instruments.summary: Security Level 1 continues; dock passes to be displayed; crew shore leave via Gate 3 only.

instruments.title: Designation of authorised bunker supply points
instruments.summary: Bunkering permitted only at designated berths and the inner anchorage, and only by licensed suppliers holding a current facility licence.

instruments.title: Ballast water record book inspection focus
instruments.summary: Concentrated inspection campaign on ballast water management plans and record books, aligned to the BWM Convention.

instruments.title: Navigational warning — survey operations, outer approach channel
instruments.summary: Hydrographic survey vessel operating in the outer approach channel; wide berth requested and speed restricted to 8 knots within 1 nm.

instruments.title: Tropical cyclone contingency — berthing restrictions and evacuation
instruments.summary: Precautionary berthing suspension and vessel evacuation to sea ahead of a severe tropical cyclone. Withdrawn once the all-clear survey completed.
instruments.body: Following meteorological tracking of a severe tropical cyclone approaching the coast, all vessels alongside shall complete cargo operations and vacate berths by 1800 hrs, proceeding to open sea or a designated safe anchorage. Port operations will remain suspended until an all-clear survey of berths, cranes and navigational aids is completed after landfall.

instruments.title: Draft navigational notice — revised pilot boarding ground
instruments.summary: Draft for approval: pilot boarding ground moved 1.2 nm seaward of the present position.
instruments.body: In draft. The pilot boarding ground would move to a position 1.2 nautical miles seaward of the present ground to give deep-draught vessels more sea room in the approach. Masters and pilotage providers are invited to comment before the notice is put in force.

instruments.title: Shore power connection — phased mandatory use at container berths
instruments.summary: Draft for consultation: phased mandatory shore power connection for container vessels alongside more than four hours.
instruments.body: In draft. Phase 1 would apply to container vessels calling at CT1 and CT2 with an alongside period exceeding four hours, from a date to be appointed. Comments are invited from terminal operators and liner agents before the instrument is put for approval.
